camel_example: aliyun maxcompute POST /api/v1/ai/data-graphs/global-graph --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"sourceKey":"metadata/odps_project/sales_orders","relationType":"REFERENCES","taskRoots":true,"maxNodes":800,"maxEdges":3000,"skeleton":true,"view":"global","zone":"metadata","scope":["metadata"],"datasourceId":"ds-01J5ZKQ8M7N2P4R6","limit":100,"domainRootsOnly":true,"datasourceName":"销售数据源","key":"metadata/odps_project/sales_orders","matchMode":"exact","direction":"out","zoneMode":"all","query":"销售订单","label":"table","targetKey":"metadata/odps_project/customers","datasourceType":"maxcompute","maxTaskRoots":40,"size":100,"usageFilter":true,"domain":"销售域","hops":1,"page":1,"operation":"search"}'
description_en: Queries the data analytics graph. If the operation parameter is not specified, the full graph is returned based on the data source. If the operation parameter is specified, the corresponding incremental graph operation is performed, such as business domain query, node expansion, search, and data source directory retrieval
description_zh: 查询数据分析图谱。不传operation时按数据源返回全量图谱；传入operation时执行对应的增量图谱操作，如业务域查询、节点展开、搜索与数据源目录
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute query-data-analysis-graph --datasource-id ds-01J5ZKQ8M7N2P4R6 --operation search --view global --key metadata/odps_project/sales_orders --domain '销售域' --query '销售订单' --direction out --source-key metadata/odps_project/sales_orders --target-key metadata/odps_project/customers --relation-type REFERENCES --page 1 --size 100 --datasource-name '销售数据源' --datasource-type maxcompute --limit 100 --zone metadata --label table --scope metadata --match-mode exact --hops 1 --usage-filter true --max-nodes 800 --max-edges 3000 --domain-roots-only true --skeleton true --zone-mode all --task-roots true --max-task-roots 40 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDataAnalysisGraph

parameters.help_en: The data source ID. The length is 1 to 256 characters. This parameter is required for full graph queries. For incremental operations, only global and datasources support this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，长度1~256个字符。全量图谱查询时必填；增量操作仅global和datasources支持该参数
parameters.name: datasource_id

parameters.help_en: The data source name filter. The maximum length is 500 characters. This parameter is used for the datasources operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据源名称过滤，最长500个字符。datasources操作使用
parameters.name: datasource_name

parameters.help_en: The data source type filter. The maximum length is 128 characters. This parameter is used for the datasources operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型过滤，最长128个字符。datasources操作使用
parameters.name: datasource_type

parameters.help_en: The expansion direction. Valid values: in (inbound edge), out (outbound edge, default), up (upward), and down (downward). This parameter is used for the expandLayer operation
parameters.help_zh: 展开方向。取值：in（入边）、out（出边，默认值）、up（向上）、down（向下）。expandLayer操作使用
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The business domain name. The maximum length is 500 characters. This parameter is required for the domain operation
parameters.help_zh: 业务域名称，最长500个字符。domain操作必填
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only the root nodes of the business domain. Valid values: true and false. The default value for full graph queries is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅返回业务域根节点。取值：true或false，全量图谱查询默认false
parameters.name: domain_roots_only

parameters.help_en: The number of hops for subgraph expansion. Valid values: 1 to 3. Default value: 1. This parameter is used for the searchSubgraph operation
parameters.help_zh: 子图扩展跳数，取值范围1~3，默认值1。searchSubgraph操作使用
parameters.name: hops

parameters.help_en: The node key. The maximum length is 2,000 characters. This parameter is required for the node, crossGraph, expandNode, and expandLayer operations
parameters.help_zh: 节点键，最长2000个字符。node、crossGraph、expandNode、expandLayer操作必填
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The node label filter. The length is 1 to 128 characters. This parameter is used for the expandNode operation
parameters.help_zh: 节点标签过滤，长度1~128个字符。expandNode操作使用
parameters.name: label

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned entries. Valid values: 1 to 2000. The limit varies by operation: the maximum value for search is 100 (default: 100), the maximum value for searchSubgraph is 200 (default: 100), the maximum value for crossGraph is 500 (default: 500), and the default value for expandNode and expandLayer is 500
parameters.help_zh: 返回条数上限，取值范围1~2000。各操作上限不同：search最大100（默认100），searchSubgraph最大200（默认100），crossGraph最大500（默认500），expandNode和expandLayer默认500
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The match mode. Valid values: exact (exact match, default) and fuzzy (fuzzy match). This parameter is used for the searchSubgraph operation
parameters.help_zh: 匹配方式。取值：exact（精确匹配，默认值）或fuzzy（模糊匹配）。searchSubgraph操作使用
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned edges. Valid values: 1 to 20000. The default value for full graph queries is 3000
parameters.help_zh: 返回边数上限，取值范围1~20000。全量图谱查询默认3000
parameters.name: max_edges

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned nodes. Valid values: 1 to 50000. The default value for full graph queries is 800. For the domain operation, the maximum value is 2000 and the default value is 1000
parameters.help_zh: 返回节点数上限，取值范围1~50000。全量图谱查询默认800；domain操作最大2000，默认1000
parameters.name: max_nodes

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of task root nodes. Valid values: 0 to 200. Default value: 40
parameters.help_zh: 任务根节点数量上限，取值范围0~200，默认值40
parameters.name: max_task_roots

parameters.help_en: The incremental graph operation type. Valid values: global (global graph), domain (business domain graph), expandNode (expand node), expandLayer (expand by layer), search (search node), searchSubgraph (search subgraph), node (node details), crossGraph (cross-graph association), edge (edge details), schema (graph schema), domains (business domain list), and datasources (data source directory). If this parameter is not specified, the request is processed as a full graph query
parameters.help_zh: 增量图谱操作类型。取值：global（全局图谱）、domain（业务域图谱）、expandNode（展开节点）、expandLayer（按层展开）、search（搜索节点）、searchSubgraph（搜索子图）、node（节点详情）、crossGraph（跨图关联）、edge（边详情）、schema（图谱结构）、domains（业务域列表）、datasources（数据源目录）。不传时按全量图谱查询处理
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000. Default value: 1. This parameter is used for the datasources operation
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围1~10000，默认值1。datasources操作使用
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. The maximum length is 500 characters. This parameter is required for the search and searchSubgraph operations
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，最长500个字符。search和searchSubgraph操作必填
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The relationship type. The maximum length is 128 characters. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and underscores. This parameter is required for the edge operation
parameters.help_zh: 关系类型，最长128个字符，以字母开头，可包含字母、数字和下划线。edge操作必填
parameters.name: relation_type

parameters.help_en: The search partition scope. Valid values: metadata (metadata), trace (trace), and knowledge (knowledge). A maximum of three values can be specified. This parameter is used for the searchSubgraph operation. If this parameter is not specified, all partitions are used by default for the own view, and metadata is used by default for the global view
parameters.help_zh: 搜索分区范围。取值：metadata（元数据）、trace（链路）、knowledge（知识），最多3项。searchSubgraph操作使用；不传时own视图默认全部分区，global视图默认metadata
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100. This parameter is used for the datasources operation
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，取值范围1~1000，默认值100。datasources操作使用
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only the skeleton graph. Valid values: true and false. The default value for full graph queries is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅返回骨架图。取值：true或false，全量图谱查询默认false
parameters.name: skeleton

parameters.help_en: The source node key of the edge. The maximum length is 2,000 characters. This parameter is required for the edge operation
parameters.help_zh: 边起点节点键，最长2000个字符。edge操作必填
parameters.name: source_key

parameters.help_en: The target node key of the edge. The maximum length is 2,000 characters. This parameter is required for the edge operation
parameters.help_zh: 边终点节点键，最长2000个字符。edge操作必填
parameters.name: target_key

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the task root nodes. Valid values: true and false. The default value for full graph queries is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回任务根节点。取值：true或false，全量图谱查询默认true
parameters.name: task_roots

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable usage filtering. Valid values: true and false. This parameter is used for the global operation
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用使用度过滤。取值：true或false。global操作使用
parameters.name: usage_filter

parameters.help_en: The visibility scope of the graph. Valid values: global (global view, default) and own (graph visible only to the current account)
parameters.help_zh: 图谱可见范围。取值：global（全局视图，默认值）或own（仅当前账号可见的图谱）
parameters.name: view

parameters.help_en: The partition filter. Valid values: metadata (metadata), trace (trace), and knowledge (knowledge). This parameter is used for the expandNode operation
parameters.help_zh: 分区过滤。取值：metadata（元数据）、trace（链路）、knowledge（知识）。expandNode操作使用
parameters.name: zone

parameters.help_en: The partition mode. Valid values: all (all partitions, default), metadata (metadata), trace (trace), and knowledge (knowledge). This parameter is used for full graph queries and the global operation
parameters.help_zh: 分区模式。取值：all（全部分区，默认值）、metadata（元数据）、trace（链路）、knowledge（知识）。全量图谱查询与global操作使用
parameters.name: zone_mode

data.description_en: The graph query result payload. A full graph query returns an object containing ok and data, where data includes nodes (node list) and edges (edge list). An incremental operation returns the result of the corresponding operation. For example, datasources returns a pagination structure containing records, total, size, and page, and domains returns a domains list
data.description_zh: 图谱查询结果载荷。全量图谱查询返回包含ok与data的对象，data内含nodes（节点列表）与edges（边列表）；增量操作返回对应操作的结果，例如datasources返回records、total、size、page分页结构，domains返回domains列表

errorCode.description_en: The error code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned to help identify the cause of the error
errorCode.description_zh: 错误码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回具体错误码，用于定位错误原因

errorMsg.description_en: The error message. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a readable error description is returned
errorMsg.description_zh: 错误信息。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回可读的错误描述

httpCode.description_en: The business status code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, the corresponding HTTP error code is returned, such as 400, 403, 404, or 500
httpCode.description_zh: 业务状态码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回对应的HTTP错误码，例如400、403、404、500

isSuccess.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure. If the call fails, check the errorCode and errorMsg fields to identify the cause
isSuccess.description_zh: 调用是否成功。true表示成功，false表示失败；失败时结合errorCode与errorMsg定位原因

ok.description_en: Indicates whether the graph query is successful. A value of true indicates that the upstream graph service returned a successful result
ok.description_zh: 图谱查询是否成功。true表示上游图谱服务返回成功结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID. It uniquely identifies the request and can be used for troubleshooting and log association
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，唯一标识本次请求，可用于问题排查与日志关联

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The graph query request body. If the operation parameter is not specified, the request is processed as a full graph query, and datasourceId is required. If the operation parameter is specified, the request is processed as an incremental graph operation. For the applicable operations of each parameter, see the field descriptions
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 图谱查询请求体。不传operation时按全量图谱查询处理，此时datasourceId必填；传入operation时按增量图谱操作处理，各参数的适用操作见字段说明
v1_body_parameters.name: body
